==Description==
'''Lunge''' may be one of the entities you migth encounter through your journey in the [[Unnamed Sector]], it is the Alt version of [[Tackle]].

==Mechanics==
When '''Lunge''' spawns, it will rush to the door, hitting it and falling, then make the same rebound warning that [[D-60]] makes before coming back to the main room, Almost exactly like [[Tackle]], but with a difference, '''Lunge''' will rebound more, and each time it changes direction it will change speeds.

==Strategies==
When you hear its spawn cue, hide, when he goes a bit far leave the locker and enter again once you hear the [[D-60]]'s rebound alert sound

==Trivia==
'''Lunge''''s old name was Shulk
